summary: Defined non-worktree branch authority using stable persisted Flow identity while retaining moving Git state as lifecycle validation.

items.title: Branch authority is required but not defined against existing branch-flow state
items.rationale: The spec now binds branch mode, canonical main-repository execution root, featureBranch, and baseBranch, and explicitly leaves ref OIDs and process HEAD to existing lifecycle checks so valid commits do not stale the binding.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements R1/R2/R4/R5/R10, acceptance_criteria, overview.decisions, and clarifications now define and test the branch authority tuple.
